question: What inbound QQ gateway frame ceiling should the bundled QQBot client enforce without rejecting valid dispatch, interaction, member, or attachment events?
rationale: The dependency supports a protective cap, but neither the PR nor the inspected documentation establishes that every valid inbound QQ event is below 1 MiB; the QQBot owner must approve this external protocol boundary.

options.title: Require contract-backed ceiling
options.body: Document or measure the largest supported inbound QQ event, choose a ceiling with explicit headroom, and add delivery plus reconnect coverage before merge.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB explicitly
options.body: A QQBot owner may accept 1 MiB as the supported protocol boundary after confirming all subscribed event families and upgrade implications.

recommendation.title: Require contract-backed ceiling
recommendation.body: Document or measure the largest supported inbound QQ event, choose a ceiling with explicit headroom, and add delivery plus reconnect coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the major current QQBot gateway and group-event architecture and are best positioned to validate its complete inbound event surface.
